facts.fact: SOS Medias Burundi reports that on 13 April 2026 the Ngozi Court of Appeal convicted journalist Sandra Muhoza of 'racial aversion' with six months already served, over information she relayed in a journalists' WhatsApp group about alleged arms distribution to ruling-party youths.
SOS Medias Burundi reports that in January 2026 Sandra Muhoza was sentenced to four years in a second proceeding over the same WhatsApp post, after more than 600 days in detention.
